summary: CPU spiking to 98% during deployment with high request latency
root_cause: Docker image build cache not cleared causing old dependencies to conflict with new code
solution: Clear Docker build cache with --no-cache flag and rebuild image. Add cache cleanup to CI/CD pipeline

summary: Memory usage climbing from 60% to 95% over 2 hours then stabilizing
root_cause: Memory leak in text preprocessing - regex patterns not properly compiled and recreated on each request
solution: Compile regex patterns once at module level instead of per-request. Add memory profiling to monitoring

summary: CPU at 75% with normal request rate after model update
root_cause: New ML model version 2.1 has inefficient attention mechanism requiring more computation
solution: Rolled back to model v2.0. Optimized v2.1 attention layers using torch.compile before next deployment

summary: Disk usage at 92% and climbing - API responding slowly
root_cause: Log rotation not configured - application logs filled /var/log directory
solution: Configured logrotate to compress and archive logs older than 7 days. Increased disk monitoring alerts

summary: Database queries taking 5-10 seconds instead of 100ms
root_cause: Missing index on classification_results table after schema migration
solution: Added composite index on (service_id timestamp) columns. Analyzed query execution plans

summary: Memory at 80% with moderate load
root_cause: Batch size increased from 16 to 64 in config but GPU memory insufficient
solution: Reduced batch size to 32 - optimal balance between throughput and memory. Document recommended batch sizes

summary: 502 errors on 30% of requests - Nginx returning bad gateway
root_cause: Gunicorn worker timeout set to 30s but model inference takes 35-40s for complex articles
solution: Increased Gunicorn timeout to 60s. Optimized model inference to target <25s. Added request timeout monitoring

summary: CPU at 100% preventing new requests from being processed
root_cause: Traffic spike from news aggregator added our API without notice - 10x normal load
solution: Implemented rate limiting (100 req/min per API key). Scaled to 3 replicas. Contacted aggregator for coordination

summary: Classification accuracy dropped from 94% to 87% over 1 week
root_cause: Training data from 2023 doesn't reflect current news topics and language patterns
solution: Retrained model with recent 3 months data. Established monthly retraining schedule. Added drift monitoring

summary: Disk at 88% - cached model artifacts not cleaned up
root_cause: Model download process saves to /tmp but doesn't clean up previous versions
solution: Added cleanup script to remove model artifacts older than 30 days. Moved cache to dedicated volume

summary: CPU sustained at 85% during morning hours (8-10 AM)
root_cause: Peak usage period coincides with news publishers morning releases
solution: Added autoscaling rule: scale to 4 replicas during 7-11 AM. CPU normalized to 50%

summary: Memory leak causing OOM kills every 6 hours
root_cause: Hugging Face tokenizer cache growing unbounded - not using context manager properly
solution: Fixed tokenizer initialization to use with statement. Added memory limit enforcement. Restart schedule as failsafe

summary: Database connection pool exhausted - new requests failing
root_cause: Max connections set to 10 but concurrent requests reach 40 during peak
solution: Increased connection pool to 50. Added connection pooling metrics. Implemented request queuing

summary: Intermittent timeouts on external API calls for fact-checking
root_cause: Third-party fact-checking API has 10s timeout but sometimes takes 15s
solution: Increased timeout to 20s. Implemented circuit breaker pattern. Added fallback to skip fact-check if API slow

summary: CPU at 70% after adding sentiment analysis feature
root_cause: Sentiment model runs on CPU instead of GPU - configuration error
solution: Updated deployment config to use GPU for sentiment model. CPU dropped to 35%. Document GPU requirements

summary: Prometheus metrics storage consuming 15GB and growing
root_cause: Retention period set to 1 year but only need 30 days for this service
solution: Reduced Prometheus retention to 30 days. Configured remote write to long-term storage. Freed 12GB

summary: Memory at 88% with normal traffic - gradual climb over 3 days
root_cause: Embedding cache not implementing LRU eviction - growing unbounded
solution: Implemented LRU cache with 10000 item limit. Memory stabilized at 55%. Added cache hit rate monitoring

summary: False positive rate increased for political news category
root_cause: Recent elections introduced new political terminology not in training data
solution: Created politics-specific fine-tuned model variant. Implemented category-based model routing

summary: All external API calls timing out - service appears down from outside
root_cause: Kubernetes network policy blocked egress traffic after security update
solution: Updated network policy to allow egress to whitelisted APIs. Added connectivity health checks

summary: CPU at 82% correlating with increased classification errors
root_cause: Unicode handling bug causes infinite loop on certain emoji sequences
solution: Fixed regex pattern to properly handle Unicode ranges. Added input sanitization. CPU to 40%
